yachts.title: Amels 78m – 2022 ENERGY
desc: AMELS 78m is currently finalising her winter maintenance in La Ciotat, which is scheduled for completion by end of April. Upon completion, she will be available for client inspections with prior notice.

As a reminder, this Amels 78m has been only used privately since her delivery in 2022 and is in immaculate condition for a new owner to step on board – she is quite simply one of the most remarkable large yachts delivered in recent years.

With a huge internal volume of 2,885 GT, she boasts all the modern amenities a buyer could desire including a large swimming pool, spacious owner’s suite with private terrace and jacuzzi, elevator, large beach club, and a sea-level gym with sea terrace, beauty salon, sauna, hammam and beach club with bar.
yachts.name: ENERGY

yachts.title: Golden Yacht 85m – 2018 O’PTASIA
desc: Built by Golden Yachts, the award-winning 85M/278’ O’PTASIA comes to market with a stellar charter reputation. Named among the World’s Finest Superyachts for Charter by Boat International, she is globally renowned as one of the industry’s top-performing charter yachts above 80m.
Following the completion of her 5-year special class survey in 2023, plus an extensive yard period and full repaint in 2024, she is today in peak condition.
Characterized by timeless lines and a superb balance between large deck spaces and voluminous interiors, she features a spacious Master suite forward on the upper deck with 180-degree views.

On the main deck is a full-beam VIP suite equivalent in size to most Master suites on the water today. All 8 further guest suites are situated on the main and upper decks, with an elevator connecting all interior guest decks.

The star of O’PTASIA’s outdoor spaces is her pool deck. Accessed via her fully equipped high-tech gym, the pool deck offers unobstructed sea views. The yacht’s beach club and wellness center, equipped with steam room, hammam and massage treatment space, lead out to a large swimming platform offering easy access to the yacht’s large collection of tenders and water toys. For further options for on-deck relaxation, the sundeck and upper deck are equipped with two large dining tables. Several further deck spaces are the ideal retreat for both large and small groups.
Her twin CAT 3516C main engines, coupled with an efficient hull form, allow her to cruise comfortably at an impressive 16 knots.
Winner of the prestigious International Superyacht Society award in the Power 65m+ category in 2019, this is a great opportunity for a new Owner to acquire an exquisite yacht.
yachts.name: O’PTASIA

yachts.title: Canadian Vickers 99m – 1943 CHRISTINA ‘O
desc: Nobody back in 1943 in Canada could have guessed the future fame of the frigate Stormont, a convoy escort. But then came 1954, when Aristotle Onassis bought her. Instead of writing history as a navy ship, she wrote history as the world’s grandest and most exalted yacht: Onassis’ legendary “Christina”. Under new ownership in 1998, she was given her new name “Christina ‘O’”. She has been restored to her old glory, through a complete refurbishment and repowering by the world’s leading experts.   She is one of the only mega yachts capable of accommodating up to 36 guests in 17 staterooms, in full compliance with SOLAS, US Coastguard and Public Health regulations.  Her history is unique…..sail back in time with the likes of Winston Churchill, Marilyn Monroe, Princess Grace, Frank Sinatra, aboard the famous ship of the legendary Aristotle Onassis and Jacqueline Kennedy-Onassis.

When Onassis bought the vessel in 1954, he converted her at an expense of over $4 million, into the largest, most modern and most exalted yacht of her era. CHRISTINA O became his floating mansion and headquarters for over two decades until his death in 1975.

In 1978 Onassis’s daughter Christina donated the yacht to the Greek Government and it eventually became disused. In 1998 the vessel was purchased by a family friend of Onassis and underwent an extensive refurbishment and re-powering, restoring her to her former glory and with the addition of all the latest technologies and equipment.

CHRISTINA O has fabulous areas for entertaining, including a sumptuous dining room capable of seating up to 40 guests. Her exterior amenities include the famous swimming pool which converts to a dance floor, a large Jacuzzi and extensive sunbathing decks.  2 massage rooms, 1 beauty room, fitness therapists are included in the charter rate no additional cost.

CHRISTINA O’s canopied decks are the ideal venue for any extra special occasion.  She can cruise with up to 157 persons and up to 250 guests can be entertained on her canopied decks for the ultimate event at dock.
– Onassis suite (bridge deck) or the Master, with Jacuzzi bathroom & private lounge ensuite with library

yachts.title: Heesen 50m – 2021 ELA
desc: ELA is arguably the most efficient hull form in her class.
Her eye-catching contemporary profile paired with a serene interior ambiance give guests an unmatched experience on board, with accommodations for 14 in 6 spacious staterooms.

A world of refined elegance greets all who step aboard ELA. Lavish living spaces adorned with the finest materials and furnishings offer guests elevated comfort and style. Floor-to-ceiling windows on both decks guarantee that no one will miss the spectacular sea views and accompanying scenery. Both the main salon and sky lounge are outfitted with furniture in organic shapes that blend seamlessly with designer pieces.
ELA’s striking exterior design and airy interior captivate onlookers and command attention wherever she sails.

yachts.title: Feadship 50m – 2000 REVERIE
desc: Lavish accommodations, irresistible alfresco spaces, and endless amenities define REVERIE, a magnificent 165′ Feadship equipped to deliver the experience of a lifetime.

Delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 and 2022, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury whilst retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in 6 comfortable staterooms.
REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.
yachts.name: REVERIE

yachts.title: Mondomarine 49m – OCEANOS 2006
desc: O’CEANOS is 161 feet of excellence in engineering and design. Fitted with Italy’s finest of woods, marble and fabrics she creates an environment of spectacular beauty and sophistication. She accommodates twelve to fourteen passengers in seven luxurious staterooms in sumptuous elegance and perfection.

Owner’s suite: spanning two thirds of the upper deck is the owner’s cabin and adjoining private office. With a remarkable panoramic view of the sea and private balcony, guests will find it hard to leave this surreal sanctuary. Designed in modern style, it features king sized bed, walk in closet, en suite bathroom and is equipped with a full entertainment system. Directly off the owner’s cabin, separated by an adjoining door and hall-way, this transferable space serves as either the private office of the owner’s cabin or as an upper salon set to entertain quiet moments of reading or interactive sessions of game playing and movie watching.

VIP Suite: The VIP cabin, set in deep rich mahogany paneling, and the adjacent twin cabin, with a lighter finish of burlwood paneling, have the unique ability to be transformed into a luxurious suite. By simply closing off the area, a private lobby between the two cabins is created and thus a separate wing of complete privacy prevails. The VIP cabin features a queen sized bed, a desk that can be used as a boudoir or office space, en suite bathroom and large windows along its starboard side. Guests will have little to envy from the Owner’s suite in this elegantly laid out space.

Double Cabin: Located on the lower deck, the 2 VIP Double Cabins, are designed with the same precision and detail as the rest of the areas on board. Their burlwood and cherry finishes provide a uniqueness while creating an ambiance of warmth.
Twin Cabins: The two twin cabins on the lower deck, which feature bleached oak walls, and ceiling panels, include Pullman beds for alternative sleeping arrangements.

The open air lifestyle on board is exemplified by the 300 square meter Sun Deck. The extendable tables, the full equipped bar with a barbeque, and the four sprawling sun beds and Jacuzzi, all work together to create an environment unlike any other. Guests can dine under the stars in pure delight, bask in the sun after a soak in the Jacuzzi or simply enjoy the breeze while relaxing in the shade. She has Satellite communications and TV, personal computer with internet access, a play station 2, a book, video, DVD, PS2 game library and a closed circuit security TV system throughout. All of the staterooms are fitted with plasma monitors and home theater systems.
M/Y O’Ceanos will guarantee her guests trips of unparalleled luxury, style and comfort.
lists: 1 x 5,9m SeaRay 185 sports with 220hp MerCruiser 4.3L inboard engine luxury tender
1 x 2,8m Zodiac with 9,9hp Yamaha outboard engine (dinghy)

yachts.name: OCEANOS

yachts.title: Sunseeker 40m – 2012 PATHOS
desc: Introducing M/Y PATHOS, a 40M/131’ yacht, part of the prestigious Sunseeker 40M series. Built in 2011 and meticulously maintained by her professional crew, PATHOS is MCA compliant and commercially registered, she is a proven success on the charter market.

With a timeless design and a gross tonnage of 338GT, PATHOS can accommodate up to 12 guests across 6 staterooms. The Owner’s Master Suite, located on the upper deck, includes a private sauna, a walk-in wardrobe, and wide balcony doors that open to the Owner’s deck lounge, offering breathtaking views. Additionally, a second full-beam Master Suite is located on the main deck, complete with a split-level bathroom and a walk-in wardrobe. The lower deck features four additional guest staterooms: two double staterooms and two twin cabins, both of which can be converted to doubles, offering a flexible layout to accommodate various guest preferences.

The expansive sundeck features a 360º view hot tub area with sun beds, a bar, and a spacious lounge area, perfect for relaxation. The main deck offers alfresco dining with fold-down hydraulic balconies, creating an open atmosphere. The aft deck provides additional dining and leisure space, while the hydraulic platform aft offers easy access to the water for watersports and tender launches.

Powered by two MTU 12V4000M93 engines, PATHOS cruises comfortably at 15 knots and reaches a maximum speed of 23 knots. Her deep-V hull design ensures smooth, efficient cruising, making her perfect for long-range voyages.
This stunning Sunseeker neatly illustrates the yard’s progression with her high-performance capabilities, luxurious accommodations, and charter-ready design.

yachts.title: Benetti Fast 125 – 2018 INSPIRATION
desc: A member of the highly successful Benetti Fast 125 series, this 125-foot (38.10m) motor yacht INSPIRATION moves through the water at a clip. Incorporating all the latest and most desirable design memes, she provides an exceptional level of performance, is beautifully designed – both inside and out – and offers a high level of safety while at sea. Her abundant features make her ideal for private or charter use. The yachts in her series were awarded Robb Report China’s Best of the Best design award for yachts between 100 and 180 feet.

She and all other yachts in the Benetti Fast 125 are driven by Rolls Royce Azipod drives, which add both speed and range to their repertoires.This motor yacht for sale boasts a range of 2000 miles at 10 knots, which is then complemented with a WOT of more than 22 knots. The yacht also features an innovative _ “wave-piecer” on the bow, which adds efficiency, and also keeps her flat while at speed. To ensure stability and comfort,  is outfitted with CMC electric Zero Speed stabilizers as well as an upgraded CMC bow thruster.
lists: 8 x Custom Stainless Steel Fridge or Freezer
yachts.name: INSPIRATION

yachts.title: CRN 50m – 1997 SAHAB IV
desc: Built for an experienced yachtsman and still owned by the family who originally commissioned her, SAHAB IV is extremely well built, like many CRN yacht’s of this era.

With interiors by Terence Disdale and exterior design by Studio Scanu, SAHAB IV strikes a rare balance between monumental architectural presence and the warmth of a private residence. From the pioneering hand-crafted murals and layered decorative finishes created specifically for the yacht, to the beautifully executed materials and meticulous detailing throughout, every element has been thoughtfully considered. The result is a yacht of authentic character, where each space feels both distinctive and effortlessly liveable.

SAHAB IV features an intelligently designed layout accommodating up to 15 guests. The arrangement includes a full-beam Master Suite and VIP suite on the main deck, four exceptionally spacious guest suites on the lower deck, and a seventh guest suite on the bridge deck. Her two large tenders, large sky lounge, family/breakfast room on the main deck and private salon on the sundeck complete her functional layout.
yachts.name: SAHAB IV

yachts.title: Azimut Magellano 30m – 2024 ARIA
desc: ARIA is a prime example of the highly acclaimed Azimut Magellano 30M crossover series, delivered in July 2024. Striking the perfect balance between long-range explorer capabilities and the ultimate luxury of a superyacht, this 97-foot (29.63m) vessel represents a rare opportunity to acquire a practically brand-new yacht without the build wait times.Featuring over €3,000,000 in custom options and upgrades, ARIA is currently listed for sale at €7.950.000, presenting exceptional value on the global market.Design & Eco-InnovationARIA’s sophisticated exterior design by Ken Freivokh perfectly complements a timeless, avant-garde interior curated by the celebrated designer Vincenzo De Cotiis.Built with Azimut’s 2nd-generation Dual Mode hull, she optimizes performance for both smooth semi-displacement cruising and efficiency, reducing fuel consumption and CO2 emissions by up to 20%. Furthermore, she features an advanced “Hotel Mode” package, powered by a high-capacity lithium-ion battery bank. This allows the yacht to run all key onboard systems in absolute silence with zero emissions for hours at anchor, eliminating the need for generators.Accommodation & LayoutARIA offers a voluminous 199 GT interior layout designed to comfortably accommodate 10 guests across 5 luxurious en-suite staterooms:Master Suite: A spectacular, full-beam owner’s cabin positioned on the main deck, flooded with natural light.Guest Staterooms: Four elegantly appointed double and twin cabins located on the lower deck.Crew Quarters: Dedicated accommodations for a professional crew of 5 to 6 members.

yachts.title: Custom Line 106 – 2019
desc: This Custom Line 106′ is the epitome of pure Italian excellence.
Delivered in June 2019. She has just 177 engine hours and she is waiting her new owner.
The concise lines of the floor and hull preserve the exemplary hydrodynamic performance of the latest models in the brand’s glider range.

The minimalist design allows the interior and exterior to merge into an elegant whole, the surfaces interlocking in an architectural harmony that erases the boundaries between spaces. The rear boasts a refined, unfussy aesthetic, while further forward the designers have conceived of larger, complementary spaces for relaxing and unwinding. The Custom Line 106′ features the owners cabin on the main deck and 2 VIP cabins and 2 twin cabins on the lower deck. Each room is a work of art, a unique story with infinite nuances.
yachts.name: Custom Line 106

yachts.title: CRN 40m – 2009 LIBERTAS
desc: The Epitome of Italian Sophistication and Tri-Deck Luxury M/Y LIBERTAS is a magnificent 39.6-meter (130ft) superyacht built by the prestigious Italian shipyard CRN (Ancona). Fully customized to deliver the ultimate yachting experience, this striking tri-deck motor yacht seamlessly blends high-performance engineering with the timeless elegance of Italian design by Zuccon International Project.
Following extensive recent refits, Libertas stands in pristine, turn-key condition, ready to offer an unparalleled level of luxury on the water.

Exquisite Living Spaces & Accommodations The interior of Libertas radiates contemporary luxury, featuring rich cherry woods, fine marbles, and bespoke soft furnishings. The Main Salon offers a vast, light-filled social hub with expansive panoramic windows, a plush lounge, and a formal dining area.The Sky Lounge on the upper deck provides a more intimate retreat, perfect for evening cocktails or movie nights.Staterooms: She comfortably accommodates 10 to 12 guests across 5 palatial cabins.

The full-beam Master Suite on the main deck is a private sanctuary featuring an independent office, walk-in wardrobe, and a lavish en-suite bathroom. Below deck, two VIP double cabins and two twin cabins (with additional Pullman berths) offer supreme comfort for family and VIP guests alike.Unrivaled Exterior Decks & EntertainmentDesigned for the ultimate outdoor lifestyle, Libertas boasts exceptional deck space distributed over three distinct levels: The Sun Deck: A spectacular entertainment hub complete with a fully equipped wet bar, commercial BBQ, ice makers, outdoor smart TVs, and an expansive lounge area.
The Foredeck: Features a private, integrated whirlpool Jacuzzi surrounded by oversized sunpads—the ultimate spot for soaking in panoramic ocean views.
Al Fresco Dining: Generous shaded dining tables on both the main and upper aft decks offer idyllic settings for world-class dining under the stars.

Powered by twin MTU 12V 4000 engines, Libertas cruises effortlessly at 15 knots with a thrilling top speed of 24 knots. Guest comfort is guaranteed at all times thanks to an advanced dual-stabilization system, utilizing both ABT Trac fin stabilizers for smooth cruising and Mitsubishi ARG zero-speed gyros for absolute stability while at anchor.Equipped with a massive 9.5m Lomac chase boat, dual Yamaha jet skis, and an extensive inventory of water toys, Libertas is the definitive choice for those seeking adventure, privacy, and uncompromising luxury.

yachts.title: Azimut Grande 27m – 2018
desc: This Azimut Grande 27 Metri, built in 2018, represents an exceptional opportunity to acquire a highly specified example of one of Azimut’s most successful Grande models.

The yacht was ordered with an extensive list of factory options and is equipped with virtually the full range of optional equipment offered by Azimut for this model, resulting in an exceptionally complete specification focused on comfort, performance and effortless operation.

Her equipment includes CMC zero-speed stabilisation, hydraulic thruster system, twin 27 kW ONAN generators, watermaker, comprehensive navigation and entertainment systems, upgraded flybridge amenities and an extensive selection of additional factory options throughout the yacht.
Powered by twin MAN V12 1900 hp engines, she combines impressive performance with the generous interior and exterior spaces for which the Grande 27 Metri is renowned.
EU VAT PAID, making her particularly attractive for private use within the European Union.
A very well-equipped Grande 27 Metri offering an outstanding specification and ready for her next owner.

yachts.title: Custom Line 112 Next – 2009
desc: Built in GRP by Italian yard Ferrretti to a design by Zuccon International, she was delivered in 2009 . RINA classed, she accommodates up to 12 guests in five cabins consisting of a master suite, VIP suite, a double and a twin with Pullman berths. All come with entertainment centres, television screens and marble bathroom facilities.

The cockpit of this yachts comes with a table, chairs, and a large sofa that can be used with the table or for facing aft to enjoy the views while listening to the music piped in from the overhead speakers. The expansive saloon has ample seating including a new settee, a bar, an entertainment centre including a 46 inch LED television screen and a Bose multimedia system, plus a separate dining area.
Outdoor living is further catered for by a large flybridge featuring seating for 10 guests, a bar, fridge, ice maker and a hydro massage tub with a top that converts into a sun pad.

yachts.name: Custom Line 112 Next

yachts.title: Custom Line Navetta 30 – 2007 HAG
desc: HAG is currently located in Athens, Greece, a strategic Mediterranean hub ideal for inspections, sea trials and immediate cruising. Thanks to her extensive refit and careful maintenance, she represents an outstanding opportunity for buyers seeking a well-proven yacht with modern systems and turnkey condition.

She is a beautifully maintained Custom Line Navetta 30 motor yacht, a timeless classic of Italian yacht design and craftsmanship. The Navetta 30 series has long been celebrated for its elegant semi-displacement hull, exceptional stability, generous interior space and comfortable long-range cruising capabilities — characteristics that have made it one of Custom Line’s most sought-after yachts in its class.

HAG launched in 2007 and designed with classic lines by top Italian naval architects, this Navetta 30 combines forgiving sea manners with refined onboard living, ideal for owners who value relaxed cruising, generous social areas and effortless seakeeping.
lists: FIRE SYSTEM: RINA CLASS CO2 AUTOMATIC FIRE SYSTEM
AIRCONDITION: CHILLER CONDARIA MAIN UNIT 4 COMPRESSOR
yachts.name: HAG

yachts.title: Azimut 103s – 2011 DUKE
desc: Azimut 103S DUKE is a superb performance yacht combining the sleek, sporty lines of the iconic Azimut S range with impressive interior volume, a unique flybridge and exhilarating performance.

Powered by twin MTU engines delivering almost 5,000 HP combined and coupled to KaMeWa waterjets, DUKE offers an impressive cruising speed of approximately 27 knots and a maximum speed of around 31 knots.

Her distinctive design combines true open-yacht performance with generous interior and exterior living areas. The expansive aft deck is ideal for entertaining and al-fresco dining, the spacious main salon benefits from large panoramic windows and a unique glass sunroof, while the flybridge provides an additional private area for relaxation and entertainment.
DUKE accommodates 8+2 guests in four ensuite cabins, while a completely separate crew area provides accommodation for up to 5 crew members.

DUKE is currently undergoing an extensive mechanical, technical and cosmetic refit, representing a significant investment in the yacht and providing her next owner with the benefit of substantially renewed machinery and essential onboard systems.

Complete overhaul of both main engines – zero hours since overhaul upon completion NEW Painting Alexeal Silver grey in progress Complete overhaul of both Kohler 40 kW generators – zero hours since overhaul upon completion Extensive overhaul and servicing of the yacht’s hydraulic systems Full service and overhaul of the KaMeWa waterjet propulsion system Service and overhaul of the thrusters New battery chargers New batteries New exterior cushions

The majority of the refit works are expected to be completed shortly, with the main engines being the final major item. Completion of the engine overhaul is currently scheduled for the end of November 2026.

This substantial refit programme represents an excellent opportunity for a new owner to acquire an Azimut 103S that has benefited from considerable recent investment in her machinery, propulsion, hydraulic and electrical systems.
When boarding DUKE, guests are welcomed onto her impressive and spacious aft deck.

This expansive area features a large sunbed for relaxing in the Mediterranean sun, elegant cream settees and a generous dining table, creating an ideal environment for both informal gatherings and al-fresco dining.
The aft deck also provides direct access to the swimming platform, allowing guests to easily enjoy the sea and access the yacht’s water toys.

One of DUKE’s most distinctive features is her flybridge, an unusual and highly desirable feature for a yacht with such sporty exterior lines. It provides an additional outdoor area for relaxation, socialising and enjoying the surroundings while maintaining the unmistakable profile of the Azimut 103S.

Further forward, guests will find another comfortable outdoor area featuring a leather settee with reddish-brown cushions, two low tables and oversized sunpads – an excellent private space for relaxing while underway or at anchor.
The aft salon doors open onto a lavishly appointed contemporary interior filled with natural daylight through the yacht’s large panoramic windows.

The panoramic wrap-around windows are complemented by Venetian blinds, allowing natural light to reflect beautifully against the rich chocolate-brown wooden floors and paneling and creating a warm and sophisticated living environment.
Discreet designer details and contrasting touches of colour add character to the elegant and harmonious interior.
One of the most striking features of the main deck is the unique glass sunroof, which allows an abundance of natural light into the salon and reinforces the open-yacht character of the 103S.
The main lounge features plush cream sofas and generous seating, while the adjoining dining area provides an elegant setting for more formal meals.
Glass doors on either side of the dining area offer direct access to the foredeck, creating an excellent connection between the interior and exterior spaces.

A wooden cabinet with a veneered white top separates the dining area from the command bridge located forward. The helm station is equipped with a comprehensive range of navigation and communication equipment.
DUKE offers comfortable accommodation for up to 8+2 guests in four ensuite cabins, all located on the lower deck.
Her flexible and charter-friendly accommodation layout consists of:
2 Double cabins 2 Twin cabins 1 additional Pullman berth in each twin cabin
The two additional Pullman berths allow the yacht to accommodate up to 10 guests when required.
This versatile arrangement makes DUKE particularly suitable for families with children, two families travelling together, or owners wishing to have additional guest capacity.
All cabins feature a clean, minimalist and elegant design, combining rich wood finishes with lighter fabrics and carefully selected colour schemes to create a sophisticated yet relaxing atmosphere.
One of the most impressive areas aboard DUKE is her spacious full-beam master suite.
Beautifully appointed, the cabin combines rich chocolate-brown tones with sumptuous cream finishes, creating a warm and sophisticated private environment.
Large windows provide abundant natural light, while full-length curtains offer complete privacy when required.
The walk-around queen-size bed is complemented by elegant bedside tables finished in rich wenge wood, while generous storage is provided through large wardrobes.
A comfortable leather sofa, veneered vanity area and large LCD TV complete the suite, creating an inviting private retreat for the owner.
The adjoining ensuite bathroom features a spacious glass walk-in shower and separate facilities for him and her.

An important feature of DUKE is her completely separate crew accommodation, providing excellent privacy and separation between the operational areas of the yacht and the owner and guest accommodation.
The dedicated crew quarters can accommodate up to 5 crew members, allowing DUKE to operate comfortably with a full professional crew.

This separation is particularly valuable both for private ownership and charter operation, ensuring that owners and guests can enjoy the yacht with a high degree of privacy while the crew can efficiently manage the vessel without interfering with the guest areas.

With her striking Italian styling, 27-knot cruising speed, KaMeWa waterjet propulsion, unique flybridge, four-cabin guest layout, accommodation for up to 5 crew and the extensive mechanical and technical refit currently underway, DUKE represents a compelling opportunity in the performance yacht market.

The combination of zero-hour-overhauled main engines and generators, extensively serviced propulsion and hydraulic systems, renewed electrical equipment and refreshed exterior areas significantly enhances her appeal for a buyer looking for an Azimut 103S with major technical works already addressed.
DUKE is available for inspection by appointment.
yachts.name: DUKE

yachts.title: Ferretti 800 – 2015
desc: This four cabin motoryacht includes besides the spacious full beam mastercabin, two VIP guest cabins and another guest cabin. Each cabin has its own en suite head. From the spacious salon with big windows you have a marvelous view over the sea. The galley in the Ferretti 800 has been placed directly forward of the raised helm in a practical ‘U’-shape. Between the galley is a bar counter where two or three people can sit on stools and chat with the chef, or have snack. From the galley you can enter the two crew cabins at the bow. For night running the galley can be closed, as can be the dinette. At the flybridge there is a large dining area with a U-shaped table, grill area and fridge, whilst towards stern there is a large sundeck. The crane permits housing of the tender, for which there is a special space on the fly. At bow, on the left hand side, there is the external steering position, raised to guarantee better vision. This Ferretti 800 will be delivered with the hardtop including a sliding, electrically opened awning. Also the by Ferretti and Mitsubishi patented ARG (Anti Rolling Gyro) stabilizers have been added to the almost full list of options.

yachts.title: Campanella 47m – 1975 ADORIA
desc: This is a 46.7 m Motor Yacht, built in Italy by Campanella and delivered in 1975.

Her top speed is 17.0 kn and her cruising speed is 14.0 kn and her power comes from two Deutz diesel engines. She can accommodate up to 14 guests in 7 staterooms, with 11 crew members. She has a gross tonnage of 540.0 GT and a 9.48 m beam.
She was designed by Franco Anselmi Boretti, who also completed the naval architecture. Franco Anselmi Boretti has designed 17 yachts and created the naval architecture for 11 yachts.

Her interior was designed by Giuseppe De Jorio (2 other superyacht interiors designed) and Paolo Scanu (4 other superyacht interiors designed) – she is built with a Teak deck, a Steel hull, and Aluminium and Steel superstructure.
She is in the top 30% by LOA in the world. She is one of 464 motor yachts in the 45-50m size range, and, compared to similarly sized motor yachts, her volume is 54.67 GT above the average.
She is registered under the United Kingdom flag, the 4th most popular flag state for superyachts with a total of 803 yachts registered.

yachts.title: Italcraft 105 – 2008 HAI LONG
desc: Year: 2008 | Length: 31.00 m | 4 Cabins | 8 Guests | 40+ Knots
HAI LONG is a striking 31-metre Italcraft 105 Maxidrago, combining aggressive Italian styling, impressive interior volume and exhilarating performance.

Built in Italy in 2008 and designed by Caputi Studio, HAI LONG represents a distinctive alternative to conventional motor yachts in her size range. Powered by twin MTU 16V2000 M93 engines developing approximately 4,864 HP combined and coupled to Arneson Surface Drives, she delivers an impressive cruising speed of approximately 35 knots and a maximum speed in excess of 40 knots.

Despite her performance-oriented character, HAI LONG offers substantial volume for a yacht of this type, with a beam of approximately 7.56 metres and 141 GT. Her generous proportions provide comfortable interior and exterior areas suitable for extended Mediterranean cruising as well as entertaining family and guests.
HAI LONG accommodates up to 8 guests in 4 cabins, providing a comfortable and private arrangement for owners and guests.

Her interior benefits from the generous beam of the Maxidrago design, creating spacious social areas and a considerably more substantial feeling than typically expected from a high-performance motor yacht.
Separate accommodation is provided for crew.
The yacht’s unmistakable profile reflects Italcraft’s performance heritage, with sleek lines, large exterior spaces and a powerful stance on the water.
Her deck areas provide ample space for sunbathing, relaxing and entertaining, making HAI LONG equally suited to fast island-hopping and extended periods at anchor.
At the heart of HAI LONG are twin MTU 16V2000 M93 diesel engines, producing approximately 2,432 HP each.
Combined with Arneson Surface Drive propulsion, this gives the yacht exceptional performance for a 31-metre vessel:
Cruising Speed: approx. 35 knots Maximum Speed: approx. 41 knots Total Power: approx. 4,864 HP

The Maxidrago 105’s hull design draws upon Italcraft’s extensive experience in the development of high-performance vessels, offering an exciting combination of speed, handling and substantial onboard volume.
yachts.name: HAI LONG

There are two staterooms with a double bed, four with twin beds and two each with a double and single bed. Two Pullman berths make for 20 pax total. Dining is enjoyed in her mahogany paneled salon around a teak table that seats up to eighteen or on the aft deck al fresco. On top of her main cabin sun mattresses are laid out for all to relax in great comfort. She can cruise with 49 passengers for day cruises.

yachts.title: Mochi Craft 64 Dolphin – 2007
desc: The Dolphin 64’ Cruiser is the boatyard’s most recent model, penned by Brunello Acampora of Studio Victory Design. It matches the harmonious, high performing shape of the hull with typical nautical taste in interiors, with the classic Dolphin teak combined with contemporary décor and design solutions.

The most impressive aesthetic feature is the increased volume of the superstructure, with the generous flybridge stretching over the cockpit. From the cockpit, furnished with a large teak table and a comfortable “form” sofa with folding backrest, a sliding glass door leads to the main deck. The lounge is a single space divided into living, dining and helm zones, while the galley is a completely separate area. At the bow, to starboard, is the renovated helm station. The lower deck features sensibly reorganised spaces. The master cabin is located amidships and features a luxury three-area en suite bathroom. The new design solutions involve furnishings as well as layout: solid wood is matched with leather details.

She is a unique model, the Moonen 96, with enviable internal volume of 45GT.  With a top speed of 33 knots, and she cruises comfortably at 28 knots powered by twin 1,250hp MAN 12V CR with low engine hours.

yachts.title: Ferretti 681 – 2006
desc: A beautifully maintained example of the highly successful Ferretti 681, combining timeless Italian design, generous interior volumes and excellent cruising performance.

Built in 2006, this Ferretti 681 has been carefully maintained throughout her life, benefiting from regular servicing and attentive ownership. During the winter months, the yacht has been stored indoors, contributing significantly to the preservation of both her exterior and interior condition.

With an overall length of 21.20 metres and an impressive 5.63-metre beam, the Ferretti 681 offers remarkable space for a yacht of this size. Her elegant profile and intelligently designed flybridge layout make her equally suited to extended Mediterranean cruising and relaxed family holidays.

The interior provides accommodation for 8 guests in 4 cabins. The full-beam Master Suite is positioned amidships and benefits from large hull windows, creating a bright and comfortable private environment. A generous forward VIP cabin and two additional guest cabins complete the accommodation, offering excellent flexibility for family and guests.

The main deck features a spacious salon with comfortable seating, complemented by a dedicated dining area. The fully equipped galley includes a ceramic cooking surface, double sink and oven, providing everything required for comfortable extended cruising.

Performance comes from twin MAN V12 diesel engines producing 1,360 HP each, currently showing approximately 1,950 engine hours. The yacht is also comprehensively equipped for independent cruising, including two generators, watermaker, navigation equipment and onboard camera system.

The Ferretti 681 remains one of the most attractive flybridge yachts of her generation, renowned for her combination of Italian styling, exceptional interior volume, comfortable accommodation and proven performance.
Presented in very good condition and ready for her next owner, this 2006 Ferretti 681 represents an excellent opportunity in the 20–22 metre flybridge market.
yachts.name: Ferretti 681

yachts.title: Posillipo 80 – 2004 AGIOS NIKOLAOS
desc: Posillipo 80 – AGIOS NIKOLAOS I The Posillipo 80 “AGIOS NIKOLAOS I” is a classic example of Italian yacht craftsmanship, combining timeless design with solid engineering and elegant interior finishes. Built in 2004 by the renowned Italian shipyard Posillipo, this 24-meter motor yacht offers exceptional comfort, performance, and style.

The yacht underwent an extensive refit in 2021, ensuring that she remains in excellent condition and fully prepared for continued cruising. Her interior features beautiful cherry wood paneling throughout, creating a warm and luxurious atmosphere that reflects the traditional elegance of Italian yacht design.

Powered by twin 1800 Hp MTU engines with 2.168 engine hours, the yacht delivers reliable performance and smooth cruising. Electrical power is supported by three MASE generators (2x 27Kw – 1 x 11Kw) with approximately 5,300, 4,700, and 4,200 hours respectively, ensuring strong redundancy and dependable onboard systems.

The spacious salon and dining area are finished with high-quality woodwork and comfortable seating, offering a refined yet welcoming environment for guests. Large windows allow natural light to flood the interior while providing excellent sea views. The yacht also features generous exterior areas, including a comfortable aft deck dining space and flybridge, perfect for entertaining or relaxing while cruising.

Designed for both private use and extended cruising, the Posillipo 80 is known for her solid hull construction, seaworthiness, and classic Italian styling, making her a highly desirable yacht in her class.

With her recent refit, low engine hours, elegant interior, and proven MTU propulsion, AGIOS NIKOLAOS Irepresents an excellent opportunity for owners seeking a well-maintained, high-quality motor yacht.

yachts.title: Azimut 68E – 2006 JASMINE BLUE
desc: This beautifully maintained 2006 Azimut 68 Evolution is offered following an extensive refit completed in 2025, making her one of the most attractive and mechanically updated examples currently available on the market.

Designed by Stefano Righini, the Azimut 68 Evolution remains one of the most successful models ever built by Azimut, combining elegant Italian styling, generous interior volumes and impressive performance. What truly sets this yacht apart, however, is the substantial investment recently made by her current owner to ensure complete reliability, modern comfort and outstanding presentation.
Rather than simple cosmetic improvements, the yacht underwent a comprehensive technical and aesthetic refit focused on delivering a true turnkey vessel ready for immediate cruising.
The mechanical package received extensive attention, including a major service of both MAN engines, providing confidence and peace of mind for her next owner.
Additional new victron battery chargers as well as new service and engine batteries have been installed on board.
The investment continued throughout the yacht with numerous upgrades to onboard systems, ensuring dependable operation and reducing future maintenance requirements.

Equally impressive are the cosmetic improvements. Both the interior and exterior have been tastefully refreshed to create a modern, elegant atmosphere while respecting the yacht’s original Italian design. The interior now offers bright, inviting living spaces finished to a high standard, while the exterior presents beautifully with refreshed entertaining areas ideal for Mediterranean cruising.
For buyers searching for an Azimut 68 Evolution without the uncertainty and expense of major post-purchase works, this yacht represents an exceptional opportunity.
• Major service carried out on both MAN main engines
• Major service carried out on both generators
• Comprehensive servicing of mechanical and onboard systems
• Interior completely refreshed with tasteful cosmetic upgrades
This Azimut 68 Evolution combines timeless Italian design with the reassurance of significant recent investment, offering her next owner a yacht that is ready to be enjoyed from day one.
yachts.name: JASMINE BLUE

yachts.title: Ferretti 68 – 2000
desc: The Ferretti 68 is a luxury motor yacht manufactured by Ferretti Yachts, an Italian yacht builder known for its high-quality craftsmanship and elegant designs. The 68-foot model was first introduced in 2002 and offers a combination of performance, comfort, and style.

Ferretti 68 features a sleek and sporty design with a streamlined hull and a spacious flybridge. It has a solid construction and a graceful profile that is characteristic of Ferretti yachts. This model has an overall length of 68 feet (20.73 meters) and a beam (width) of approximately 18.5 feet (5.48 meters). It typically offers comfortable accommodation for up to 8-10 guests in 4 cabins, including a master cabin, VIP cabin, and two twin cabins. Crew quarters are usually separate and located at the bow.

The interior of this Ferretti 68 is known for its luxurious finishes and attention to detail. It features high-quality materials, such as fine woods, leather upholstery, and marble accents. The salon area is typically spacious and well-appointed, providing a comfortable living and dining space. The yacht’s flybridge is a popular gathering spot, offering a helm station, sun loungers, a wet bar, and ample seating areas for relaxation and entertainment. The aft deck often features a dining table and seating, perfect for al fresco dining and enjoying the ocean views. The Ferretti 68 is powered by twin MAN 1180hp diesel engines, typically providing a cruising speed of around 24-27 knots and a top speed of approximately 33-35 knots.

yachts.title: Tropida Genesis 31 – 2022
desc: Tropida is a Greek boatbuilder specializing in the design and manufacture of high-performance RIBs for demanding private and professional use. Each vessel reflects a deep commitment to naval engineering, structural integrity, and uncompromised offshore handling.

At the heart of every Tropida lies a purpose-built stepped hull – designed in-house – that delivers exceptional lift, directional stability, and a soft, dry ride in rough conditions. Proprietary features such as the Antidive System, Double Chine geometry, and Bow Step profile are not just technical highlights; they are essential innovations that ensure safety, speed, and fuel efficiency in every sea state.

Among its flagship models, the Genesis 31 stands out as a pure expression of Tropida’s design philosophy. Engineered for offshore performance, it combines aggressive hydrodynamics with refined ride quality and structural strength. With power options up to twin 400 HP, a top speed exceeding 70 knots, and cruising efficiency of just 1.8 L/NM at 35 knots (tested with twin Mercury 300HP), the Genesis 31 delivers unmatched performance without compromise.
From fast chase boats to offshore cruisers, Tropida crafts each model with meticulous attention to balance, trim behavior, and long-range usability – offering not just power, but precision.
Built in Greece, tested in the Aegean, and engineered for the world.
yachts.name: Tropida Genesis 31
